title: backlog.py's usage text for dispatch does not name --resume ID --message FILE
goal: The usage text of _tools/backlog.py names dispatch --resume ID --message FILE beside the other dispatch flags, and the dispatch line of backlog.py --help names --resume, so backlog.py lists it

run:
import re, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog
doc = backlog.__doc__ or ""
entry = re.search(r"\n  backlog\.py dispatch ID.*?(?=\n  backlog\.py )", doc, re.S)
entry = entry.group(0) if entry else ""
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--help"], capture_output=True, text=True)
bad = []
if "--resume ID --message FILE" not in entry:
    bad.append("the usage entry of dispatch does not name --resume ID --message FILE beside the other dispatch flags")
if "--resume" not in r.stdout + r.stderr:
    bad.append("backlog.py --help does not name dispatch --resume")
print("; ".join(bad) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
